events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip
start=124738680; end=124738772; chrom='chr11'
with gzip.open('data/hg38ToHg19.over.chain.gz','rt') as f:
    in_chain=False
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('chain'):
            p=line.split()
            # chain score tName tSize tStrand tStart tEnd qName qSize qStrand qStart qEnd id
            tName=p[2]; tStart=int(p[5]); tEnd=int(p[6]); qName=p[7]; qStrand=p[9]
            if tName==chrom and not (tEnd<=start or tStart>=end):
                header=p
                tpos=tStart; qpos=int(p[10])
                in_chain=True
            else:
                in_chain=False
            continue
        if not in_chain or not line.strip():
            continue
        nums=list(map(int,line.split()))
        size=nums[0]
        b_t_start=tpos; b_t_end=tpos+size
        b_q_start=qpos; b_q_end=qpos+size
        if b_t_end>start and b_t_start<end:
            ov_start=max(start,b_t_start); ov_end=min(end,b_t_end)
            q_ov_start=b_q_start+(ov_start-b_t_start)
            q_ov_end=b_q_start+(ov_end-b_t_start)
            print('header', header)
            print('block', b_t_start,b_t_end,'->',b_q_start,b_q_end,'overlap',ov_start,ov_end,'maps',qName,q_ov_start,q_ov_end,'qStrand',qStrand)
        if len(nums)==3:
            tpos += size + nums[1]
            qpos += size + nums[2]
        else:
            tpos += size; qpos += size
PY"

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
for id in E003 E066 E067 E068 E069 E070 E071 E072 E073 E074 E081 E082; do
  f=data/roadmap/${id}_15_coreMarks_mnemonics.bed.gz
  [ -s "$f" ] || curl -sS -L -o "$f" "https://egg2.wustl.edu/roadmap/data/byFileType/chromhmmSegmentations/ChmmModels/coreMarks/jointModel/final/${id}_15_coreMarks_mnemonics.bed.gz"
done
python3 - <<'"'PY'
import gzip, glob, os
start=124608576; end=124608668
labels={
'E003':'ESC/H1', 'E066':'Liver', 'E067':'Brain angular gyrus', 'E068':'Brain anterior caudate', 'E069':'Brain cingulate gyrus', 'E070':'Brain germinal matrix', 'E071':'Brain hippocampus middle', 'E072':'Brain inferior temporal lobe', 'E073':'Brain dorsolateral prefrontal cortex', 'E074':'Brain substantia nigra', 'E081':'Fetal brain male', 'E082':'Fetal brain female'}
for path in sorted(glob.glob('data/roadmap/E*_15_coreMarks_mnemonics.bed.gz')):
    eid=os.path.basename(path).split('_')[0]
    hits=[]
    with gzip.open(path,'rt') as f:
        for line in f:
            c,s,e,state=line.rstrip().split('\\t')[:4]
            if c=='chr11' and int(e)>start and int(s)<end:
                hits.append((int(s),int(e),state))
    print(eid, labels.get(eid,''), hits)
PY"
